text.ms:
1. Perintah ini bolehlah dinamakan Perintah Kawalan Bekalan

(Barang-Barang Kawalan) (No. 4) 2019.

Barang-barang kawalan

2. Barang-barang yang dinyatakan dalam Jadual diisytiharkan sebagai

barang-barang kawalan bagi tempoh dari 20 Oktober 2019 hingga 2 November 2019.

JADUAL

BARANG-BARANG KAWALAN

1. Daging kambing tempatan bertulang

2. Daging kambing dan bebiri import bertulang

3. Tomato

4. Cili merah

5. Cili kering

6. Kubis bulat import (Indonesia dan China, tidak termasuk kubis Beijing)

7. Bendi

8. Kacang dal (Australia)

Dibuat 14 Oktober 2019

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XI]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Menteri Perdagangan Dalam Negeri

dan Hal Ehwal Pengguna

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES ACT 1961

CONTROL OF SUPPLIES (CONTROLLED ARTICLES) (NO. 4) ORDER 2019

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the

Control of Supplies Act 1961 [Act 122], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the Control of Supplies (Controlled Articles)

(No. 4) Order 2019.

Controlled articles

2. The articles specified in the Schedule are declared to be controlled articles for

the period from 20 October 2019 to 2 November 2019.

SCHEDULE

CONTROLLED ARTICLES

1. Local bone-in mutton

2. Imported bone-in mutton

3. Tomato

4. Red chilli

5. Dried chilli

6. Imported round cabbage (Indonesia and China, not including Beijing

cabbage)

7. Lady's finger

8. Dal (Australia)

Made 14 October 2019

[KPDN(PGK)(S)0.5001/4 Jld. 8; PN(PU2)188/XI]

DATUK SERI SAIFUDDIN NASUTION BIN ISMAIL

Minister of Domestic Trade

and Consumer Affairs
